message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes (3 of 3).

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now decomposes accented characters and removes the accent marks before it calls `slugify`.

I left `vendor/slugify/index.js` alone. It's a vendored copy of slugify 1.2.0 whose header says not to edit it by hand. Because of that, `src/shop/product-url.js` still drops accented letters from product URLs. If you want the same fix there, it needs the same change or an upgrade of the vendored package.
